description: Implementation of the ru_dummy_impl class managing slot timing, sector coordination, and loop execution for a radio unit dummy module in a 3GPP-like system.

classes.name: ru_dummy_impl
classes.description: Class implementing dummy radio unit logic, including slot timing, sector management, and asynchronous looping.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the system slot, resets stop control, starts sectors, and begins the main loop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all sectors and signals the loop to terminate.

methods.name: defer_loop
methods.description: Schedules the main loop to run asynchronously unless a stop is requested.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main execution loop that updates slot timing, notifies boundary events, and reschedules itself.
